title: Keep caregiver requirements authoritative throughout weekly planning
body:
## Problem

The model can pass an empty constraint list or the wrong check kind for an already fetched restaurant, overwrite a failed verdict, and admit that venue to the weekly plan. A malformed recommendation purpose also remains attached to fetched candidates and prevents a later corrected call from producing a meal.

## Change

Use the caregiver's saved requirements and each retained candidate's purpose for constraint checks. Re-evaluate checked candidates when assembling the final plan and its explanations. Validate recommendation purpose before contacting the provider or retaining any candidates. Existing model tool names and parameters remain compatible.

This changes `agent.py` and adds two native regression modules plus one verification receipt. Existing care heuristics, venue data, provider configuration, frontend and calendar behavior retain their implementations. The configured-model and error-continuation contributions in #2/#3 remain separate; their exact stacked source was used for compatibility qualification.

## Verification

- Lead independently reran the full product suite: **41 passed, 22 subtests passed, zero skips**.
- The 20-method constraint suite reproduces 15 affected methods on original main and passes normally and under optimized Python on the correction.
- Two additional methods reproduce invalid-purpose recovery/state mutation failures on the first candidate and pass after the guard, including seven malformed inputs and the actual FastAPI request path.
- Composition with exact #3 head `7002a16a3b46c7318826ce9975fd812096925f42` (including #2): **52 passed, 28 subtests passed, zero skips**.
- Complete healthy outputs for all three synthetic personas are unchanged. Five independently reviewed valid mixed-purpose sequences retain byte-identical results.
- All provider data in these checks is synthetic; no live inference or venue request was made.

Source baseline: `d1c7a4e39cfdc0bb5b9fe026bc9660b75b456e81`. Published tree `ede072c8c630e8f7e015416b92226337577294b9` preserves all 16 unowned original files, with exact readback of the four intended blobs. Final `agent.py` blob: `2c9e4ea6a4d36a35ef31668f33f22d210e4c9e52`.

Ownership: `estate-8304a40f6f50`, under Jacob's autonomous execution mandate. Current #4 owners explicitly retain frontend/calendar/request-lifecycle scopes. The earlier ownership-issue creation was rejected by GitHub's temporary secondary content-creation limit; this PR is the durable source and scope record after cooldown.

Detailed provenance and replay commands: `docs/verification/constraint-binding-20261008.md`.
